short_description.value: Easy to learn, hard to put down: place tiles, match color or symbol, clear passages off the board. The casual classic is back — completely overhauled, with four modes, over 300 levels, and for the first time two players on one screen: together or in a Duel.

about.value:
Passage 5 is the new entry in a series that has been with many of our players for over twenty years. The principle has always been the same — and that's exactly the point: place your tiles so that either the color or the symbol matches the adjacent tiles. Complete rows and columns — the passages — disappear from the board.

Sounds simple. It is. And that's what makes it so good: a puzzle you grasp in thirty seconds and still can't put down three hours later. Plan ahead and clear several passages at once — play on instinct and you'll have to get creative.

For the fifth installment, we rebuilt the game from scratch: calmer, cleaner, no frills. Playable with mouse, keyboard, or gamepad.


Four game modes

- Clear — Free up the marked fields. Over 300 hand-crafted levels.
- Continue — Place tiles endlessly, as long as the board allows.
- Classic — Classic high-score chasing.
- Construct (new) — The counterpart to Clear: instead of clearing fields, you have to fill specific fields with tiles. Feels different again from the three classics.


Two players for the first time

- Coop — Two players at one screen, two separate cursors, shared score. Look at the board together, plan together, win together.
- Duell — Shared board, each player gets their own half. Who clears first? Choose between multiple levels, best-of, or Last Man Playing.
- Devices are assigned FIFA-style: whoever confirms on their input device is in. Keyboard, mouse, multiple gamepads — all in parallel.


More depth for the veterans

- Four difficulty levels — new: Master, for those who find Hard too easy
- Optional move timer on the higher levels — switch it off if you don't want the pressure
- Streak system: how many tiles can you place in a row without a mistake?
- Special tiles: bomb, row and column bomb, joker, and blocker
- Symbol numbers on every tile as a visual aid — no squinting needed


High scores, saves, and events

- Steam Achievements and Steam Leaderboards — new to the series
- Online leaderboards in addition to local high scores
- Events — time-limited challenges with their own leaderboard
- Multiple save slots with individual player names, switchable at any time
- Separate high-score tabs per mode and difficulty


Features at a glance

- Four game modes: Clear, Continue, Classic, Construct
- Coop and Duell for two players
- Four difficulty levels including Master
- Over 300 levels in Clear mode
- Steam Achievements and Leaderboards
- Multiple save slots with individual player names
- Special tiles, streak system, optional move timer
- Full control via mouse, keyboard, or gamepad
- Spoken tutorial — no long reading required
- Atmospheric sound effects and background music
- Custom tile designs can be loaded

ea_why.value: We want to improve the game based on the first user feedback. Especially the two multiplayer modes, Duel and Coop, should be played by the community so we can make the right adjustments.

ea_difference.value:
Besides ongoing gameplay improvements, the release version will include more campaigns — meaning more backgrounds and tile sets.

A new campaign called "Art Collection" will be added in the release version.

The structure and order of the levels will likely change.

We want to use the feedback from Early Access players to fine-tune the gameplay.

We see the biggest need for Early Access in the multiplayer area, since these features can't be fully tested by us alone.

ea_state.value:
We are currently working on balancing the levels and campaigns.

We will take part in the Steam Next Fest with a demo.

ea_pricing.value: There will be a discount during the Early Access phase, and the release price will be higher afterwards.

ea_community.value:
Feedback will be fed directly into development.

The multiplayer aspect in particular is a new feature, and we're hoping for plenty of input from you to help refine it.

We look forward to lively communication with the Steam community via email and our Discord channel:
https://discord.gg/eDURb5Yn
